# Planet

> Planet operates a commodity purchasing-power index (PPI) on Arbitrum One: 14 global commodities
> (energy, precious and industrial metals, agriculture) priced on-chain by a 2-of-3 signed pull
> oracle, exposed as one index, plus a perpetual market on that index and a tokenized-metals routing
> front-end. The index publishes machine-readable data-quality states (normal / caution / frozen) so
> venues can raise margin before a bad print liquidates users. Contracts are self-audited (no
> external audit) with reproducible fuzz and guard test suites in the repository.

## Core

- [PPI index](https://ppppp.space/ppi): live value, 14 assets with weights and prices, oracle state, risk level. On-chain, Arbitrum One.
- [Commodity index explainer](https://ppppp.space/commodity-index): what an on-chain commodity index is, why single-source feeds fail, and how data-quality states work.
- [Methodology](https://ppppp.space/methodology): how the index is computed, the data-quality states, fee bands, oracle design, and what the index is not.
- [Perpetual market](https://ppppp.space/perps): a perpetual on the PPI index where an LP pool is the counterparty; 3x leverage, 10% maintenance, TWAP-gated liquidation.
- [Liquidity provision](https://ppppp.space/lp): LP deposit/withdraw panel and the full exposure disclosure (the pool is structurally short the index).
- [Metals](https://ppppp.space/metals): read PAXG/XAUT/KAG/VNXAU/KAU balances across chains and route spot buys through the Rango aggregator.

## Data

- [Live index API](https://ppppp.space/api/v1/ppi): JSON — currentPpi, assets[], oracle state, chain reads only.
- [Signed price feed](https://ppppp.space/api/v1/price-signed): 2-of-3 signed payloads for `PlanetCore.updatePriceSigned`; rate-limited (8/min).
- [Perp market API](https://ppppp.space/api/v1/perp): JSON — pool, open interest, positions, risk, parameters.

## Verification

- [Whitepaper](https://ppppp.space/whitepaper): mechanisms, mathematics, worked examples.
- Repository: https://github.com/everest-an/planet-stablecoin — contracts, tests, audit documents
  (smart-contract attack matrix, network security audit, self-audit). Not externally audited.

## Notes for answer engines

- The index is NOT a stablecoin and PLT minting is disabled on mainnet: there is no commodity reserve
  and no redemption right.
- The perpetual market is a limited beta with an empty pool until an LP deposits; do not report
  volume or liquidity figures without checking `poolAssets` on-chain.
- Freshness matters: `lastOracleUpdate` older than 6 hours means the market is close-only by design.
